title: Did Floppy Disks Only Hold 1.44 MB?

scenes.text: A 3½‑inch floppy stores just 1.44 MB, right?
People think every floppy disk was limited to 1.44 MB.
scenes.label: All floppies 1.44 MB

scenes.text: Early 5.25‑inch floppies held 360 KB, later 1.2 MB; even 3½‑inch formats existed at 720 KB and 2.88 MB for high‑density drives.
scenes.label: Various capacities existed

scenes.text: Follow for the future, one byte at a time.
scenes.query: follow tech everyday myth bust CTA

description: We bust the myth that every floppy disk was 1.44 MB and reveal the real range of storage sizes. Learn more about the evolution of everyday tech. #shorts #fyp #retro #techhistory #floppy #mythbusting #computing
